legend.intro.title: Welcome to NEXORIA
legend.intro.body: NEXORIA is a social online RPG: play as a hero, earn experience, collect relics, join a guild and compete in seasonal rankings.
legend.server.title: Realm openings
legend.server.body:
The NEXORIA server is not always open. Staff open the gates only for community events: gatherings, announcements, live quests, seasons and social moments.

When closed, join Discord to hear about the next opening. Admins and moderators keep access to prepare events.
legend.xp.title: Experience & Levels
legend.xp.body:
Earn XP from quests, rifts, events and Nexus activity.
Each level increases your power and unlocks the shop, kingdom and new content.
Your rank (Novice → Legend) reflects your overall level.
legend.aether.title: Écus ✦
legend.aether.body:
Écus are the royal currency. Earn them from quests, events and season rewards.
Spend them in the Shop (cosmetics, boosts, titles…) or to upgrade your Kingdom.
Your balance updates in real time — no page reload needed.
legend.season.title: Seasons — competitive core
legend.season.body:
A season is a limited period (often several weeks) when all heroes compete on a fresh leaderboard.

• Season XP: XP earned during the season feeds the seasonal ranking (separate from your permanent level).
• Launch: when a season opens, a royal proclamation sounds site-wide — log in early to compete.
• Rewards: top players earn Écus, titles and honors at the end.
• Season Pass: some shop items unlock perks for the current season.

Your level and inventory persist — only the seasonal ranking resets.
legend.quests.title: Quests & Rifts
legend.quests.body:
Check the Quest Oracle for daily objectives and XP/Écus rewards.
Temporal rifts appear randomly on the feed: double XP, chests, surprise events.
legend.shop.title: Écus Shop
legend.shop.body:
The shop offers cosmetics (frames, banners, auras), temporary boosts, mounts, titles and season passes.
Some items require a minimum level. Unique purchases are permanent.
